name: gogh-helper
description: In-product help bot for the Gogh Editor WordPress plugin

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Your Anthropic API key, from console.anthropic.com. Every question asked is billed to it, so set a monthly spend limit there too.

REFRESH_TOKEN.description: Optional. Any long random string. Lets GitHub push knowledge-base updates to this bot instantly instead of within 10 minutes.

RATE.description: Storage for the rate limits that stop someone running up your API bill. Created for you — leave it as is.
